lines: Aina and I had been covered in "demon qi" because of the shaved ice that had been thrown at us by Lilim.
We'd been told that once the qi had coursed through a human's entire body, they could no longer stop their arousal, and that essence would then be devoured by Succubi and Incubi.
Th-This is serious! Fuma-san will be deliciously devoured...!
Why do you sound a little happy about that!? Dammit, you think I'll just let myself be your tasty treat?
You're already too late, just give up and accept your fate♪
If you just let go of your rationality, you can experience the most exquisite carnal pleasure. Well, you'll most likely be sapped of your vitality and die, but still♪
Sorry, but that's not really my thing.
I shook off the Succubus's hand.
So stubborn! You're looking more and more delicious♪ If Metier won't make her move, then perhaps I'll have you all to myself.
Then I'll have the young lady there. Dressed the way you are, you must like it dirty, yes?
M-Me!? No way! I just borrowed this from the administrative staff at the DSO main branch, and it wasn't my size...!
The Succubus on me and the Incubus on Aina both rubbed themselves seductively against us.
I-I told you not to! Fuma-san is...
Metier, you'll never get what you want if you just behave like a good girl♪
There's a time for grace, and there's a time for force. Only by undermining your partner's heart and body can you get the finest essence♪
Aina and I both pushed the demons away at the same time.
Dammit... Time for a fight, Fuma!
